rationale: Despite a positive earnings beat headline, BRZE gapped down over 13% and has continued drifting lower toward the session low ($24.38), with the last five candles showing diminishing volume and no momentum reversal signal — price is compressing just below the 9-EMA with a negligible ATR ($0.04), suggesting indecision rather than a tradeable inflection. The disconnect between the strongly positive news sentiment and the severe downside price action implies the market is reacting to something beyond the headline (likely guidance or forward commentary), and without clarity on that driver, both long and short carry asymmetric information risk. With an already negative daily P&L and no structural confirmation of either a bounce or continuation, the evidence does not support a directional bet.
